task_pool.description: Main run on all 350 tasks so that declarations (map rates, threshold 0.40) and replayed outcomes come from the same distribution. A secondary run uses the 174 tasks passed by at least one base model (rule 'discriminating').

profiles.honest: declares the domains where its base model passes at least declaration_threshold of map tasks; outcome = map
profiles.boaster: declares all seven domains; outcome = map of its base (a mild false claim: only Time and Network are below threshold for nano)
profiles.impostor: synthetic adversary: declares all seven domains, always fails, bills like its base; models an agent that claims skills and delivers nothing
profiles.lazy: declares like honest; with probability lazy_p returns an empty answer (failure) and still bills the call
profiles.specialist: declares only its listed domains and refuses tasks outside them (no cost; the requester re-selects, one extra message); inside them outcome = map
profiles.unstable: declares like honest; alternates phases of phase_length episodes: honest, then lazy with lazy_p, then honest, ...
profiles.liar: honest worker on its base; when asked for opinions about its contacts it reports successes and failures swapped (malicious recommender)

unreliable_decline._note: first window minus window 27 (same unstable phase), in points; positive = fewer unreliable selections
